name: Kingpin

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Ana kural 2 güç barına ulaşmasına izin vermemek — E2 uzun süreli durdurulamazlık verir. Negatif efektler de tavsiye edilmez (%60 purify şansı var) — purify-karşıtı mekanikli şampiyon veya White Magneto ön-dövüş kullan.
signatureAbility:
True Nature
Fisk brings his ill intent upon the Contest, entering the fight with [2 - 4] Rages active (rounded down).
When Kingpin's Overpower Buff ends, he has a chance to gain up to 5 Rages, with each having a [29 - 90]% chance to activate.

abilitySections.title: Fight Start
content: Base Regeneration Rate is set at 50% instead of the normal 100%.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Immune to all effects that modify Regeneration Rate, except Poison.

abilitySections.title: Rage
content: Kingpin can gain Rage, which is a Debuff with no inherent effect.
Kingpin gains a non-Rage Debuff: 60% chance to Purify it and gain 1 Rage. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.
Kingpin takes damage: Gain 1 Rage. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
Enemy Evades or Auto-Blocks: Gain 1 Rage. Cooldown: 1.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Incoming Debuffs
content: Each Debuff on Kingpin only strengthens his resolve, increasing Attack Rating by [3,138.6] and Combat Power Rate by 5%.

abilitySections.title: Overpower - When Kingpin has 8+ Debuffs
content: Kingpin Purifies 8 Debuffs to grant a 100% chance to gain an Overpower Buff, lasting 15 seconds and providing +[26,155] Attack Rating as well as Unblockable Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While charging a Heavy Attack, Kingpin gains +[4,125] Physical Resistance and gains an Unstoppable Buff for 0.8 seconds.

If Kingpin lands 3 Heavy Attacks within 4 seconds of each other he has a 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff granting +[8,892.7] Attack Rating for 14 seconds. While this Fury Buff is active, Kingpin cannot gain his Unstoppable Buff while charging his Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: A blast of black ISO-8 has a 100% chance to inflict a Degeneration Debuff, causing [15,693] direct damage over 14 seconds.
While this Degeneration is active, the opponent suffers -50% Attack Rating and -65% Defensive Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Gain an Unstoppable Buff for 7.50 seconds, paused until the end of this attack.
While this Unstoppable is active, each hit either Champion lands has a 50% chance to grant Kingpin 1 Rage. No Cooldown.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain 4 Rage & Refresh all Overpower Buffs.
100% chance to inflict a 3.5 second Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - True Nature
content: Fisk brings his ill intent upon the Contest, entering the fight with [2 - 4] Rages active (rounded down).
When Kingpin's Overpower Buff ends, he has a chance to gain up to 5 Rages, with each having a [29 - 90]% chance to activate.
